YS-ZET-VOICE-CHECK-004.actor_access: p539 and p568 directly expose leverage through visible presence; p554-557 explicitly confirms sincere rescue purpose, alongside manipulation.
YS-ZET-VOICE-CHECK-004.inference_ceiling: No universal self-sacrifice or constant gentleness. Calm wording can carry uncompromising action; private motives remain local.

YS-ZET-VOICE-CHECK-005.inference_ceiling: Late particular relationship, not timeless warmth or retrospective original-lawfulness.

YS-ZET-VOICE-CHECK-007.syntax_and_act: Concrete task request, authority limits and prospective work language retain hierarchy despite thanks.
